latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Maker by Descript.

- Instantly edit and export 1080p polished videos by simply describing your desired edits.
- Automatic removal of filler words and silences; add captions and social content with no timeline dragging or complex settings.
- Seamless onboarding with anonymous authentication, session creation, and credits system (100 free credits per token).
- Cloud rendering pipeline delivers finished videos in 1–2 minutes; supports uploads up to 500MB.
- Multiple export formats: mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac.
- Streamlined workflows for one-click edits, batch processing, session resuming, and iterative refinement.
